title: Minimum-Cost Merging
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n. Line 2: n pile sizes in row order. Merging
two ADJACENT piles costs their total size; make one pile with minimum
total cost.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 500; 1 ≤ a[i] ≤ 10^6.

Interval DP with prefix sums: O(n^3) is fine at n = 500.

tests.name: four piles checkpoint
three piles checkpoint
greedy bait
tests.hint: The locally-cheapest adjacent merges are not globally optimal; the DP finds the true optimum.
